source_audit.source_name: Northern Ireland Planning Portal public register

source_audit.license: Planning Portal terms allow viewing/downloading for permitted uses; Crown material may be reusable under OGL v3, but portal content has restrictions on wider redistribution. Store factual metadata, IDs and source URLs only.
